messages:
maria: quick FYI — starting a 1% canary for model v3.2-int4 on user-chat slice now. primary checks: hallucination rate (longform), top-k rerank MRR, and p99 latency.
jon: noted. which baseline are we comparing against? v3.1-fp16?
maria: yea v3.1-fp16 as baseline. also shadowed v3.2-nf4 in parallel for rerank sanity.
kevin: please target the new composite gate we discussed earlier (consensus across metrics). can you paste the canary config? :eyes:
maria: pasted below — short and sweet.
```
canary_policy: {
  traffic: 1%,
  duration: 12h,
  metrics: ["mrr_rerank", "halluc_rate_longdoc", "p99_latency_ms"],
  pass_rules: [
    {metric: "mrr_rerank", comparator: "delta", threshold: -0.01},
    {metric: "halluc_rate_longdoc", comparator: "increase_pct", threshold: 0.02},
    {metric: "p99_latency_ms", comparator: "relative", threshold: 1.25}
  ],
  composite_rule: "majority_pass_and_no_metric_exceed(critical)",
  autofallback: {window_mins: 30, trigger: "any_critical_exceed"}
}
```
anya: can we make the hallucination check stricter for long-docs? last time the int4 had a small bump only for >2k tokens.
maria: good call — updating: halluc threshold -> 0.01 for seqlen>2048. I'll push new gate in 5.
jon: also add a cold-start probe: sample 50 cold sessions and assert p95 latency < 350ms. we saw cold tail drift with int configs.
kevin: reminder: deploy-bot will annotate rollout with the version mapping. @deploy-bot can you tag the shadow runs so telemetry links are visible in the canary dashboard?
deploy-bot: tagged canary 1765432109 with shadow runs v3.2-nf4; telemetry links: https://console.redwood/telemetry/canary/1765432109 :white_check_mark:
maria: running smoke eval now — quick status in ~10m. will post initial deltas.
anya: if we see marginal mrr loss but big cost win, suggest we consider a staged split (1% -> 5% -> 25%) with an additional gating check at 5% for user-visible fidelity slices.
jon: agree. propose hysteresis: require 2 consecutive 1h windows of stable metrics before progressive ramp.
kevin: and add an automatic rollback threshold: if halluc_rate_longdoc increases by >1.5x baseline OR p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for more than 20min -> instant rollback. keep the window conservative.
maria: updated config pushed. TL;DR: stricter longdoc halluc threshold, coldstart p95 probe, 2-window hysteresis, instant rollback on critical tail breach.
anya: :thumbsup: please also tag the eval set used (longdoc-v2) in the canary metadata so we can reproduce.
maria: done — metadata added (longdoc-v2, rerank-sample-2026-03-21). posting initial numbers in 12m.
kevin: thanks. if numbers look sketchy we'll snapshot weights and do an offline head-to-head with the same seed set. Avoid noisy hand re-sampling.
jon: one last ask — log the prefix-hit cache rates. int4 KV-cache warmup has been flaky and it affects early latency.
maria: ack. adding cache warmup telemetry.
maria: initial results: mrr_rerank delta -0.006 vs baseline (within pass), halluc_rate_longdoc +0.009 for seqlen>2048 (just under the stricter 0.01), p99_latency 1.18x baseline (under 1.25). cache warmup ramp looked slightly slower (p50 warm at 4min).
anya: that halluc bump is close. what's the CI on the estimate? small N for longdocs can be noisy.
maria: CI ~0.005 (95%). it's borderline but trending ok. planning to hold 1% and run another 12h sample.
kevin: I'm comfortable with the staged ramp given those numbers, but keep the instant-rollback hook armed. also schedule an eval job to run the longdoc halluc detector offline at 10k samples.
jon: agree. set the 1% -> 5% timer for 12h if next window is stable.
maria: applying 12h hold. will post next window at 1765435678. thanks all.
